mods.name: Pet Evolution

releases.notes:
# Release: pet-evolution v2.0.1

## Download

- **JAR File:** `petevolution-2.0.1-mc1_21_1.jar`
- **Size:** 91KiB

## Release Notes

Pipeline verification release: Kotlin DSL migration, cache isolation, CurseForge/Modrinth auto-publish.

## Installation

1. Download the JAR file from the assets below
2. Place it in your mods folder:
   - **Client:** `%APPDATA%/.minecraft/mods/`
   - **Server:** `server/mods/`
3. Launch Minecraft with NeoForge

## Support

- 📖 [Documentation](https://github.com/nobody174/Minecraft/tree/main/mods/pet-evolution)

mods.name: GlowTools Server+Client
mods.description:
GlowTools Server+Client makes your tools glow with particle effects when held in hand.
Uses server-side positioning for accurate weapon location and third-person rendering.
Requires both server and client installation.
